67475-where-stillwater-runs-deep.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Well, as you say, making maps on a typewriter is no joke, and I guess you’d earn your money all right!” Her employer noted the clearing of Christine’s placid blue eyes, gave another inarticulate snort and returned to his own problem, knowing that Christine was unlikely to repeat his words.

arxiv-2106-10003.title: Improving Performance of Seen and Unseen Speech Style Transfer in End-to-end Neural TTS
arxiv-2106-10003.creator: Xiaochun An, Frank K. Soong, Lei Xie
arxiv-2106-10003.description: Abstract End-to-end neural TTS training has shown improved performance in speech style transfer. However, the improvement is still limited by the training data in both target styles and speakers. Inadequate style transfer performance occurs when the trained TTS tries to transfer the speech to a target style from a new speaker with an unknown, arbitrary style.

arxiv-2207-07650.title: Contrastive Brain Network Learning via Hierarchical Signed Graph Pooling Model
arxiv-2207-07650.creator: Haoteng Tang, Guixiang Ma, Lei Guo, Xiyao Fu, Heng Huang, Liang Zhan
arxiv-2207-07650.description: Abstract Recently brain networks have been widely adopted to study brain dynamics, brain development and brain diseases. Graph representation learning techniques on brain functional networks can facilitate the discovery of novel biomarkers for clinical phenotypes and neurodegenerative diseases. However, current graph learning techniques have several issues on brain network mining.

arxiv-2304-13547.title: An effective semilocal model for wave turbulence in 2D nonlinear optics
arxiv-2304-13547.creator: Jonathan Skipp, Jason Laurie, Sergey Nazarenko
arxiv-2304-13547.description: Abstract The statistical evolution of ensembles of random, weakly-interacting waves is governed by wave kinetic equations. To simplify the analysis, one frequently works with reduced differential models of the wave kinetics. However, the conditions for deriving such reduced models are seldom justified self-consistently.

arxiv-2305-19470.title: Label Embedding via Low-Coherence Matrices
arxiv-2305-19470.creator: Jianxin Zhang, Clayton Scott
arxiv-2305-19470.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jianxin Zhang, Clayton Scott. Label embedding is a framework for multiclass classification problems where each label is represented by a distinct vector of some fixed dimension, and training involves matching model output to the vector representing the correct label. While label embedding has been successfully applied in extreme classification and zero-shot learning, and offers both computational and statistical advantages, its theoretical foundations remain poorly understood.

arxiv-2308-07623.title: On mesh coarsening procedures for the virtual element method
arxiv-2308-07623.creator: Daniel van Huyssteen, Felipe Lopez Rivarola, Guillermo Etse, Paul Steinmann
arxiv-2308-07623.description: Abstract In the context of adaptive remeshing, the virtual element method provides significant advantages over the finite element method. The attractive features of the virtual element method, such as the permission of arbitrary element geometries, and the seamless permission of ‘hanging´ nodes, have inspired many works concerning error estimation and adaptivity.

arxiv-2311-14867.title: Disaggregating Time-Series with Many Indicators: An Overview of the DisaggregateTS Package
arxiv-2311-14867.creator: Luke Mosley, Kaveh Salehzadeh Nobari, Giuseppe Brandi, Alex Gibberd
arxiv-2311-14867.description: Abstract Low-frequency time-series (e.g., quarterly data) are often treated as benchmarks for interpolating to higher frequencies, since they generally exhibit greater precision and accuracy in contrast to their high-frequency counterparts (e.g., monthly data) reported by governmental bodies. An array of regression-based methods have been proposed in the literature which aim to estimate a target high-frequency series using higher frequency indicators.

arxiv-2402-04357.title: Building Retrieval Systems for the ClueWeb22-B Corpus
arxiv-2402-04357.creator: Harshit Mehrotra, Jamie Callan, Zhen Fan
arxiv-2402-04357.description: Abstract The ClueWeb22 dataset containing nearly 10 billion documents was released in 2022 to support academic and industry research. The goal of this project was to build retrieval baselines for the English section of the "super head" part (category B) of this dataset.

arxiv-2406-08159.title: Quadratic perturbations of the Schwarzschild black hole: The algebraically special sector
arxiv-2406-08159.creator: Jibril Ben Achour, Hugo Roussille
arxiv-2406-08159.description: Abstract We investigate quadratic algebraically special perturbations (ASPs) of the Schwarzschild black hole. Their dynamics are derived from the expansion up to second order in perturbation of the most general algebraically special twisting vacuum solution of general relativity. Following this strategy, we present analytical expressions for the axial-axial, polar-polar and polar-axial source terms entering in the dynamical equations.

arxiv-2407-09733.title: Textured-GS: Gaussian Splatting with Spatially Defined Color and Opacity
arxiv-2407-09733.creator: Zhentao Huang, Minglun Gong
arxiv-2407-09733.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce Textured-GS, an innovative method for rendering Gaussian splatting that incorporates spatially defined color and opacity variations using Spherical Harmonics (SH). This approach enables each Gaussian to exhibit a richer representation by accommodating varying colors and opacities across its surface, significantly enhancing rendering quality compared to traditional methods.

arxiv-2601-18357.title: Resolution Dependence in Magnetohydrodynamic Simulations of Neutrino-Driven Core-Collapse Supernovae 2015 Resolution Dependence in Magnetohydrodynamic Simulations of Neutrino-Driven Core-Collapse Supernovae – References
arxiv-2601-18357.creator: Vishnu Varma, Bernhard Müller
arxiv-2601-18357.description: Abstract We investigate the role of resolution and initial magnetic field strength on core-collapse supernovae in simulations of a non-rotating 13 ​ M ⊙ 13\mathrm{M_{\odot}} progenitor. Specifically, we study the effect on shock revival, explosion dynamics, and the properties of the compact remnant.

openalex-w2131618757.creator: Fernando Dini Andreote, Diego Javier Jiménez, Diego Chaves, Armando Cavalcante Franco Dias, Danice Mazzer Luvizotto, Francisco Dini‐Andreote, Cristiane Cipola Fasanella, Maryeimy Varon Lopez, Sandra Baena, Rodrigo Gouvêa Taketani, I. S. de Melo
openalex-w2131618757.description: Here we embark in a deep metagenomic survey that revealed the taxonomic and potential metabolic pathways aspects of mangrove sediment microbiology. The extraction of DNA from sediment samples and the direct application of pyrosequencing resulted in approximately 215 Mb of data...

plos-pone-0005099.creator: Bertrand Gonthier, Eric Koncina, Saulius Satkauskas et al.
plos-pone-0005099.description: PLOS ONE research article. There is increasing evidence for a crucial role of proteases and metalloproteinases during axon growth and guidance. In this context, we recently described a functional link between the chemoattractive Sema3C and Matrix metalloproteinase 3 (MMP3). Here, we provide data demonstrat

pmc-10596870.title: Artificial light at night and breast cancer risk: The findings from CECILE study (France)
pmc-10596870.creator: N Prajapati, E Cordina, A Boileau, E Faure, P Guénel
pmc-10596870.description: BackgroundEnvironmental exposure to artificial light at night (LAN) has become ubiquitous in modern societies. Experimental and epidemiological studies suggested that LAN exposure disrupts circadian rhythm, inhibits melatonin production, and increases the risk of breast cancer.ObjectivesWe aimed to assess the association of exposure to outdoor LAN with breast cancer risk, along with possible effect modifications of this association.

pmc-11347930.title: Behçet's disease presented with obscure gastrointestinal bleeding: A Palestinian case report
pmc-11347930.creator: Afnan W M Jobran, Abdelrhman Janem, Tareq Alhor, Muhammad Idris, Mustafa Nabilsi, Salam Mughrabi, Aisha Alfakhry, Hazem Ashhab
pmc-11347930.description: Key Clinical MessageIt is important to recognize and manage gastrointestinal symptoms in patients with BD, as they are linked to high rates of mortality and morbidity. BD can affect any part of the gastrointestinal tract, and prompt diagnosis and appropriate treatment are essential to prevent complications.

pmc-11399704.title: Aquacultural source of nitrous oxide revealed by nitrogen isotopes
pmc-11399704.creator: Yang Wang, Guangbo Li, Qixing Ji
pmc-11399704.description: Highlights•Aquaculture species impact the source of sedimentary N2O production.•Aquaculture pond sediment produces N2O more effectively than overlying water.•Partial denitrification is the major source of N2O and is linked to nitrite level. Introduction Nitrous oxide (N2O) is a trace and long-lived greenhouse gas, with potent ozone depletion potential signifying its importance in climate change (Ravishankara et al., 2009).

pmc-11517807.title: Assessing cancer prevention literacy among European population: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11517807.creator: P Romeo-Cervera, M Pinto-Carbó, A Blanco-Cabañes, M A Torres-Mariner, J Fons-Martínez, M Vanaclocha-Espí, S Castán-Cameo, T de Pablo-Pardo, A Molina-Barceló, BUMPER Consortium
pmc-11517807.description: BackgroundCancer prevention literacy (CPL) is essential for empowering individuals to make health-informed decisions and adopt preventive measures to reduce their cancer risk. This study aims to measure CPL among the European population.MethodsA cross-sectional population-based study was conducted from February to March 2024 among European residents over 18 years old (N = 2312) in the context of BUMPER Project (https://bumper.cancer.eu/).

pmc-11519791.title: Brain-to-heart cholinergic synapse-calcium signaling mediates ischemic stroke-induced atrial fibrillation
pmc-11519791.creator: Yingran Liang, Gongxin Wang, Siwen Fan, Junyi Zhang, Shuang He, Guixiang Pan, Guoliang Hao, Yan Zhu
pmc-11519791.description: Background: Stroke-related cardiovascular diseases have attracted considerable attention, with atrial fibrillation (AF) being among the most frequent complications. Despite increasing clinical evidence, experimental models of stroke-induced AF are still lacking, hindering mechanistic discoveries and the development of adequate therapeutics targeting this stroke-heart syndrome (SHS).

pmc-11593634.title: Genetic Modifiers of Hemoglobin Expression from a Clinical Perspective in Hemoglobinopathy Patients with Beta Thalassemia and Sickle Cell Disease
pmc-11593634.creator: Michael D. Diamantidis, Georgia Ikonomou, Ioanna Argyrakouli, Despoina Pantelidou, Sophia Delicou
pmc-11593634.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Hemoglobinopathies, namely β-thalassemia and sickle cell disease (SCD), are hereditary diseases, characterized by molecular genetic aberrations in the beta chains of hemoglobin. These defects affect the normal production of hemoglobin with severe anemia due to less or no amount of beta globins in patients with β-thalassemia (quantitative disorder), while SCD is a serious disease in which a mutated form of hemoglobin distorts the red blood cells into a crescent shape at low oxygen levels (qualitative disorder).

pmc-11660206.title: Circulating lipoprotein(a) in patients with nonalcoholic fatty liver disease: a systematic review and meta‐analysis
pmc-11660206.creator: Aikaterini Nikoli, Myrsini Orfanidou, Antonis Goulas, Dimitrios G. Goulis, Stergios A. Polyzos
pmc-11660206.description: Background and AimAlthough nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) and lipoprotein(a) [Lp(a)] are associated with cardiovascular diseases, existing data on Lp(a) in NAFLD are conflicting. The aim of this systematic review and meta‐analysis was to summarize and compare data on circulating Lp(a) between NAFLD patients and non‐NAFLD controls.MethodsA systematic literature search was performed in PubMed, Scopus, and Cochrane Library.

pmc-12694893.title: Short- and Mid-term Outcomes of the Extravascular Implantable Cardioverter-defibrillator in Pediatric and Adolescent Patients: A Single-center Experience
pmc-12694893.creator: Nikola Dragisic, Emily R Backes, Lindsey Malloy-Walton, Edo K Bedzra, William J Gibson, Philip M Chang
pmc-12694893.description: Experience with the Aurora extravascular (EV) implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) (Medtronic, Minneapolis, MN, USA) remains limited among pediatric centers in contrast to its broader implantation in adults. We evaluated our single-center experience with the EV ICD as part of our standard ICD options for treatment of malignant ventricular arrhythmias in pediatric subjects.

pmc-12913167.title: Persistently high prevalence of HPV16 and rising prevalence of non-16/18 HR-HPV genotypes in cervical precancer and cancer in Latvia in 2016-2024 shape the severity of cervical disease
pmc-12913167.creator: Liba Sokolovska, Karina Biserova, Arta Spridzane, Daira Krisane, Alesja Dudorova, Svetlana Gebrila, Ilvija Krasovska, Dmitry Perminov, Beatrise Orlova, Marta Petrovska, Juris Jansons, Androniks Mitildzans, Jurijs Nazarovs, Maria Isaguliants
pmc-12913167.description: BackgroundCervical cancer incidence and mortality in Latvia is one of the highest in Europe, but data on HR-HPV prevalence in cervical disease are lacking. We aimed to investigate HR-HPV prevalence in cervical squamous cell carcinoma (CSCC) and cervical dysplasia (CD), association with disease severity, and prevalence changes over time.

uslaw-usc-t31-s1117.title: 31 U.S.C. § 1117 — Exemption
uslaw-usc-t31-s1117.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t31-s1117.description: United States Code, Title 31 (Money And Finance); Chapter 11 (The Budget And Fiscal, Budget, And Program Information). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Director of the Office of Management and Budget may exempt from the requirements of sections 1115 and 1116 of this title and section 306 of title 5, any agency with annual outlays of $20,000,000 or less.

uslaw-usc-t46-s80505.title: 46 U.S.C. § 80505 — Enforcement
uslaw-usc-t46-s80505.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t46-s80505.description: United States Code, Title 46 (Shipping); Chapter 805 (Safe Containers For International Cargo). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In General.— To enforce the Convention, this chapter, and regulations prescribed under this chapter, the Secretary of the department in which the Coast Guard is operating may— (1) examine, or require to be examined, containers in international transport; (2) approve designs for containers.
